• Crazy Love Sunbelt ®
• KO 02/1100-10

rows.ARS:
Orange blend Shrub.
Exhibition name: La Villa Cotta ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tim Hermann Kordes (Germany, 2002).
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 2013 as 'La Villa Cotta'.
Introduced in United States by Newflora™ LLC in 2015 as 'Crazy Love'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow, copper shading, light pink outer petals. Mild fragrance. 125 to 135 petals. Average diameter 3.5". Medium to large, very full (41+ petals), in large clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Rounded buds.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, upright. Semi-glossy, medium green foliage. 7 leaflets.

Height: up to 47" (up to 120cm). Width: 2' to 35" (60 to 90cm).
rows.Patents:
European Union - Application No: 2013/2202 on 21 Aug 2013
United States - Patent No: PP 26,870 on 28 Jun 2016 VIEW USPTO PATENT
Application No: 14/120,937 on 11 Jul 2014
The new variety of rose plant of the present invention originated from a controlled crossing in a breeding program of two distinct parents during the summer of 2002. The crossing was between an un-named seedling, the seed parent, and another un-named seedling, the pollen parent by the same inventor.
rows.Notes: Named after a garden festival in Laubach, Germany.
